_readme: S730 subject-title hunt (group html_a), 2026-11-25, under Sam's ask in session S730: the catalog's printed heading for each course subject code, for the local subject titles that decide each code's common subject (ruling r-no-mid-on-a-stray-code-sam-2026-11-25). Cañada's robots.txt refuses /current/ to readers, so this reads the hand-filed copy of the 2026-2027 catalog (kb/hand_filed_catalogs/ca_ada.json, Sam's download of 2026-10-17) and prints only the lines above each subject's first course, as el_camino_subject_headings.json does. One load of the copy, no model call. Second read: the first (run 45626678601) took each code's first course from the program pages, which end by page 232, so this one starts at page 233. Third read: the second (run 45628047809) still met program pages through page 243, the last page with a course code, so this one prints the copy's table of contents (pages 1 to 8) to find where, or whether, it prints course descriptions.

questions.contents: Where the copy prints its course descriptions, or that it prints none.
